positions.description:

positions.title: iOS Developer Intern
positions.description:
*Fully virtual*
iOS App Developer
• Worked as an iOS Mobile developer on a NCR’s white-label application and NCR’s Aloha POS
• Implemented real time-synchronous data using Google’s Cloud Firestore Firebase
• Created real-time remote iOS push notification using a custom web server written in ReactJS
• Prototyped and presented a demo of smartwatch interface at NCR’s Hackathon
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Firestore · Swift (Programming Language) · iOS Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
· Contributed to Agile team methodologies including Daily Scrums and Sprints to increase production speed using Jira Software
· Designed and implemented a new front-end web GUI feature using VueJS that was implemented on all the currently worked on DoD projects.
· Automated a SVG image rendering gadget using user-selected details and generated specific SVG file layers using XML Parser
· Fetched API with jQuery & JSON
· Used ActiveMQ to allow remote control of front-end
· Built the back-end in Python for interacting with the database
· Wrote a script to automatically fix and check code formats depending on the GitLab Pipeline requirements

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
• Won the 2019 Peer Review Award at Georgia Tech
• Designed and simulated a 24 GHz antenna on HFSS software
• Manufactured and tested the antenna using Eagle software
• Successfully prototyped a 24 GHz Tag at less than -10 dB on a PCB milling machine with 6.9 realized gain
• Presented a poster abstract at the 2019 IEEE RFID Conference and NCUR 2019

honors.title: 2019 ORS Research Award “Peer Review Award”
honors.issuer: Issued by Electrical and Computer Engineering at Georgia Institute of Technology · Apr 2019

projects.title: GT_Trader
projects.description:
This project is designing and implementing a classic open-source Palm Pilot game called Space Trader. The original game was developed by Pieter Spronck. See external link: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Space_Trader_%28Palm_OS%29 (Links to an external site.)Links to an external site. for historical details.

Created iOS App for CS 2340 extra credit assignment, produced in under 48 hours.
Android Version: https://github.com/gearkim0614/GT_Trader

projects.title: RPG Video Game Design
projects.description:
• Built a 2D game on Embed platform that controlled a character by using an accelerometer.
• Created multiple 11x11 pixel sprites for NPCs, items, character, and more.
